subject: Advance funding ramp: invoice windows, drawdown cadence, and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Trevor Mills <trevor@acme-retail.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Ivanova <sasha@acmeretail-finance.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Prepay plan — alignment on invoicing windows and VAT

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited about moving forward with a $1.2M annual prepay commitment to Redwood for production inference. Before we finalize internal approvals I need to confirm how invoices and drawdowns will be phased — our procurement team needs exact invoice dates, amounts, and the VAT handling for our EU/UK subsidiaries.

Specifically:
- Can you provide a proposed invoice schedule (dates + tranche amounts)?
- Do you provide VAT invoices per country and what evidence will you supply?
- Will we be able to request partial drawdowns on demand within agreed windows?

I've attached a draft SOW and our internal procurement template for context.

Regards,
Trevor
Treasury Operations — Acme Retail
[Attachment: Acme_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Trevor Mills <trevor@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Sasha Ivanova <sasha@acmeretail-finance.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prepay plan — alignment on invoicing windows and VAT

Trevor — thanks, appreciate the clarity. Looping in Lauren (billing ops) and Karthik (tax/payments) to confirm.

High-level proposal we typically use for $1M+ annual prepays:
1) Three invoice tranches to align with quarter boundaries to simplify accounting (50% / 30% / 20%)
2) Each tranche will be invoiced with country-specific VAT invoices where applicable; we provide a VAT evidence pack (sample invoice + VAT breakdown + company registration)
3) Drawdown flexibility: we support an invoice/window model — invoice funds are reserved on receipt; teams can request drawdowns from the reserved balance within a 60-day window after invoice date. We can add an escrow trigger for larger customers if required.

Lauren & Karthik — can you confirm the exact invoice dates we can commit to for the proposed split and what evidence package we can deliver at signing? Also attaching the carve-out invoice plan template for your reference.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Plan_Q4-2026.xlsx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prepay plan — alignment on invoicing windows and VAT

Connor / team — happy to confirm operationally. Based on our current quarterly calendar I recommend these invoice dates (client-visible):
- Invoice #1: 2026-10-15 — 50% ($600,000)
- Invoice #2: 2027-01-03 — 30% ($360,000)
- Invoice #3: 2027-04-01 — 20% ($240,000)

Notes/constraints:
- We will issue pro-forma invoices 7 business days before the invoice date to allow PO/approval in your systems.
- Drawdown window: funds cleared to Redwood will be available for drawdown for 60 calendar days post-clearing. Requests after the window require approvals and may be treated as a new drawdown.
- VAT: we produce VAT-compliant invoices per legal entity. Karthik, can you attach the VAT evidence template we send to customers?

Attaching: VAT_Evidence_Template.xlsx — includes certificate of VAT registration, sample invoice, and data fields we need from Acme for EU/UK invoicing.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: VAT_Evidence_Template.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prepay plan — alignment on invoicing windows and VAT

Quick tax notes for Acme:
- For customers with EU subsidiaries we will issue local VAT invoices if you provide the VAT registration numbers for each billing entity.
- When customers are VAT-registered in their country, the invoice will show VAT at the local rate. If Acme is VAT-exempt for certain purchases, we need formal evidence (reverse charge documentation).
- Evidence pack we supply at signing: VAT_Evidence_Template.xlsx (attached), company VAT cert, Redwood VAT registration, and sample invoice.

If Acme needs split invoices across multiple legal entities (e.g., UK + FR), tell us the billing entity mapping and we will produce separate invoices per tranche.

Karthik Iyer
Finance — Tax & Payments
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Trevor Mills <trevor@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Sasha Ivanova <sasha@acmeretail-finance.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed invoice schedule and next steps (DocuSign + PO)

Trevor — based on Lauren's and Karthik's inputs, here's the formal proposed schedule and required materials from Acme so we can lock invoices and enable drawdowns: 

Proposed invoice schedule (amounts are gross, VAT shown separately where applicable):
- Invoice 1 (50%): Issue 2026-10-15, funds due within 14 days of invoice date
- Invoice 2 (30%): Issue 2027-01-03, funds due within 14 days
- Invoice 3 (20%): Issue 2027-04-01, funds due within 14 days

Data we need from Acme to issue VAT-compliant invoices per entity:
- Billing entity name and legal address for each country
- VAT registration numbers per entity (if applicable)
- Purchase order numbers for each tranche (if your procurement requires PO-based processing)

Operational details:
- Once we receive cleared funds for Invoice 1 we will open a reserved balance and provide a drawdown form. Drawdowns can be requested via the Console or by emailing billing@redwood.com within the 60-day window.
- Escrow: optional, we can set up an escrow account if your internal policy requires it — we typically do that for >$2M commitments, but we can discuss an exception.

Next steps:
1) I will send the DocuSign with the final SOW + Invoice Schedule for signature (link below).
2) Acme to return VAT numbers and PO (if needed).
3) Finance will generate pro-forma invoice 7 business days before 2026-10-15.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEFG123456789
Attached: Redwood_Invoice_Plan_Q4-2026.xlsx (breakdown by tranche).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk the procurement team through the flow.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199
[Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Plan_Q4-2026.xlsx]

From: Sasha Ivanova <sasha@acmeretail-finance.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Trevor Mills <trevor@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed invoice schedule and next steps (DocuSign + PO)

Connor / team — this works for us. We'll: 
- Confirm billing entity mapping by EOD Monday (Oct 4)
- Return PO# for Invoice 1 by Oct 8 so you can issue pro-forma on Oct 6 (7 business days before 10/15)
- Review DocuSign and return signed SOW this week

One quick ask: can the pro-forma include the VAT amount per country line so our AP team can pre-validate? If you can include sample invoice numbering that would be helpful too.

Thanks,
Sasha Ivanova
Senior AP Manager — Acme Retail
[internal note: attaching to PO system once we have DocuSign back]
